title: Error
description: The error envelope every non-2xx response carries. Branch on `code`, show `message`. Codes are stable and only ever added: unauthenticated (401), forbidden (403), not_found (404), method_not_allowed (405), validation_failed (422), immutable_field (422: a read-only or create-only field sent with a value other than the current one; `errors` names the fields), change_refused (422) and its specific forms — default_project_protected, project_not_empty, project_not_in_workspace, workspace_has_no_projects, key_revoked, key_not_revoked, default_route_protected — rate_limited (429), server_error (500). Treat an unknown code by its HTTP status.

errors.description: validation_failed and immutable_field: messages per request field (dotted path for nested fields).
